## Definition of Done

Check an item only when verified. Explain anything not applicable or still open under **Gaps and exceptions**. Product Owner acceptance and peer approval should stay unchecked until they occur.

### Requirements & Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The implementation matches the Jira story.
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion is implemented.
- [ ] No agreed requirement is missing.

Acceptance criterion → implementation/test evidence:

### Testing & Test Coverage

- [ ] Named Confluence test cases were executed and passed.
- [ ] New or modified test cases were reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant positive, negative, and boundary cases were considered.
- [ ] Regression tests passed.

Case IDs, commands, results, and skipped checks:

### Code Quality & Peer Review

- [ ] Code logic was verified as correct.
- [ ] Coding conventions were followed.
- [ ] At least one team member reviewed and approved the code.
- [ ] Review comments were resolved.

### Documentation & Traceability

- [ ] Jira reflects the final behavior.
- [ ] Test cases and their traceability were updated.
- [ ] API, database, or architecture documentation was updated where affected.
- [ ] Confluence or README was updated where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implementation.

### Integration & CI/CD

- [ ] The change integrates with related components.
- [ ] CI pipeline passed.
- [ ] Automated tests passed.
- [ ] Build or deployment succeeded where applicable.
- [ ] No regression was introduced.

### Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] Security and authorization were reviewed.
- [ ] Performance was reviewed.
- [ ] Reliability and consistency were reviewed.
- [ ] Auditability and logging were reviewed.
- [ ] Scalability was reviewed where relevant.

Security evidence:

- [ ] CodeQL passed or its findings were reviewed.
- [ ] Secret scanning passed or its findings were reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private keys, or real production data were added.

### UI/UX (for UI changes)

- [ ] Design is consistent.
- [ ] Validation and error states are covered.
- [ ] Loading and empty states are covered.
- [ ] Usability requirements are met.

### Product Owner / Final Acceptance

- [ ] Product Owner checked the story against its acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Product Owner confirmed the relevant documentation and evidence are complete.
- [ ] Product Owner accepted the story after all applicable DoD checks passed.
